page.heading: Agent rollouts
page.description: Update the agent one wave of servers at a time, and send commands to servers that are offline.

servers.heading: Servers
servers.noAgentHint: Polaris drives this server through its SSH login, so there is no agent here to update.
servers.pinBody: Rollouts of any other version leave this server alone until you unpin it.
servers.empty: No servers yet. Add one from Servers.

rollout.heading: Rollout
rollout.none: No rollout yet. Start one when a new agent version is out.
rollout.startBody: The first wave is a canary of a few servers; each later wave is the share of servers reached once it is done. A wave starts only when every server in the one before it has stayed healthy for the whole check.
rollout.versionHint: The version each agent must report once updated
rollout.wavesHint: Canary servers, then cumulative percentages ending at 100, e.g. 1, 10, 50, 100

halted.failed: Halted because a server failed its health check. Retry it, or roll back.
halted.manual: Halted by an admin. Resume to carry on.

rollout.rolledBack: Rolled back. The servers it reached are pinned to {version}; an older build cannot be installed again from here.
rollout.rolledBackNoPrevious: Rolled back. No earlier version was known, so nothing was pinned.
rollout.rollbackBody: No further wave runs, updates still waiting are cancelled, and every server it reached is pinned to {version}.

queue.addBody: If the server is offline the command waits for it and goes out in order when it answers again.

results.noAgent: This server has no agent to update
results.unknownAssignment: That template is no longer on this server
results.unreadable: The command could not be read
results.interrupted: Cut off while it was being sent

errors.rolloutOpen: A rollout is already in progress. Finish or roll it back first.
errors.noRollout: There is no rollout in progress.
errors.notHalted: Only a halted rollout can be resumed.
errors.noTargets: No server needs this version: they already run it, are pinned, or have no agent.
errors.queueFull: This server already has 50 commands waiting. Cancel some first.
errors.unknownServer: That server is no longer in Polaris.
errors.unknownAssignment: That template is not assigned to this server.
errors.notCancellable: That command has already been sent.
errors.badWaves: Waves must rise and end at 100.
errors.invalid: Check the values and try again.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
